どうして勝てないんですの！？
あたくしも成長しているはずですのに！
text.official_en:
How could she possibly win? Gah! Here I thought
I'd improved.

おやおや、どうしたんだい？
そんなにむくれちゃってさ。
text.official_en:
Oh, what's the matter now? You've got yourself
really worked up there.

レイリダーナに歌の勝負を挑んだんですけど
また負けてしまったんですわ！
text.official_en:
I challenged Leilidahna to a song contest—and I lost
to her. Again!

text.jp:
何度やっても超えられませんの！
悔しくてなりませんわ！
text.official_en:
No matter how many times I attempt to, I cannot
outdo her. It's maddening!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ジャスミン

若いねえ。
そんなことでいちいち怒ったりするなんて。
text.official_en:
Youthful pride! Getting wound up over each and
every single time you lose.

当然ではありませんこと！？
あなたは負けることが悔しくありませんの？
text.official_en:
But that's natural. Surely you, too, are frustrated
when you are defeated.

text.jp:
傭兵なんてやってると慣れちまうのさ。
負け戦に巻き込まれるのも珍しくないからね。
text.official_en:
You get used to it, being a mercenary. You're gonna
be on the losing side of a battle now and then.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ジャスミン

そもそもあたしが傭兵になったのだって
仕えてた貴族の家が潰れちまったからなんだ。
text.official_en:
Why, the whole reason I became a mercenary was
because the house I served ran into bad times.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ジャスミン

言ってみりゃ、この稼業自体が
負けから始まったようなもんだ。
text.official_en: So, you could say, defeat made me.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ジャスミン

text.jp:
だから、勝てないからって、
毎度怒ってたら身が持たないってわけ。
text.official_en:
If I let myself get mad every time I didn't win,
I'd probably fall to pieces before long.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_オリンピア

なるほど……
たくさんの苦境を乗り越えてきましたのね……
text.official_en:
I see. You've persevered through much adversity to
survive as you have.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_オリンピア

text.jp:
でも、悔しいという気持ちを持ち続けるのも
大事だと思いますの。
text.official_en:
Still, I believe that frustration may be a crucial
driving force for the person who feels it.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_オリンピア

また戦おうという熱意が湧いてくるんですもの。
text.official_en:
It's because of that feeling that the will to fight
effervesces within me.

Makes me want to try again and again, as many
times as it takes. Do you not feel the same?

あたしにもこだわりってのはあるよ。
text.official_en: I...see your point. I'm driven by certain things too.

I'm bent on rebuilding my old mercenary group,
so I can bring all my pals back together.

But making a living like I do, there's no time to think
about much but gaining more profit than loss.

Guess I just stow my feelings somewhere that
they won't get in the way.
